tokens.name: site-brand
tokens.usage: Layer 1, site branding: the Theme panel's brand color (Aura --lwc-brandPrimary, published as --dxp-g-brand). Every block reads it as --ftk-site-brand unless the block sets its own Brand Color. The FlowToolKit green of the Forms design system; swap it per client.

tokens.name: site-accent
tokens.usage: Layer 1: the site's second brand color (--dxp-g-brand-1). Blocks read it as --ftk-site-accent: gradient second stops, accent pills, timeline dots.

tokens.name: site-text
tokens.usage: Layer 1: the Theme panel's text color. Body copy on light blocks.

tokens.name: site-navy
tokens.usage: Layer 3, a block surface: the deep navy the demo designs use as a dark block Background (background key).

tokens.name: site-surface-muted
tokens.usage: A light block Background for alternating bands.

families.sans: "DM Sans", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: part-gap
tokens.usage: Layer 2, --ftk-site-part-gap: the one gap between a block's header, body, buttons and footnote.

tokens.name: widget-gap
tokens.usage: Aura's space between two components stacked in one section column (--lwc-uiWidgetMarginBottom, 1.5rem).

tokens.name: column-gutter
tokens.usage: A section column's outer padding; 8px between neighbouring columns.

tokens.name: radius-shell
tokens.usage: --ftk-site-radius-shell: the corners of an Inset Band block.
